scope: Default composition uses the existing shared cancellation bridge. Real provider stream is dropped after root cancellation from another handle. Completed and interrupted waits retain Cancelled outcomes after all handles are dropped and the composition is reopened, without model dispatch. Root cancellation survives cold reopen and prevents rerun. This focused checkpoint does not qualify every cancellation/effect race, cross-process signalling or installed terminal behavior.
limits: Five-second post-cancellation stop checks; separate 120-second preparation watchdogs. Previous integrated parallel fault preparation failures remain open.
